questions.q: Which congruence criterion applies when all three sides of two triangles match?
In SAS, which two things must match?
options: Two angles and the included side
Two sides and the included angle

questions.q: In ASA, the matching side must be...
options: Included between the two matching angles

questions.q: If only two sides of two triangles match, with no angle given, can you prove congruence?
options: Only if the triangles look similar
